data.name: Fragmented Soul: Blackrock
data.detailed_description:
"They fall from the skies. They are not just meteors. They are alive. And they want everything."

- Commander Rhaegon Voss, BCF High Command

In Blackrock, you are the last line of defense - a Commander of the Blackrock Containment Force (BCF). Your mission: stop the spread of a sentient meteorite known only as the Blackrock, before it corrupts the planet entirely.

Dropped into hostile terrain with only a portal, a shard generator, and your launchpad, you’ll need to summon and command units called Bravelings — autonomous fighters born to resist the Glimmergrubs, the grotesque minions spawned by the Blackrock.

Features:

Command the BCF – Step into the boots of a tactical Commander with real-time combat control.

Fend off Glimmergrubs – Face swarms of corrupted enemies that evolve and swarm relentlessly.

Summon Bravelings – Use collected shards to deploy autonomous soldiers that fight by your side.

Upgrade Everything – Enhance your troops, defenses, generator, and your own combat skills.

Tactical Base Defense – Protect the generator, and outlast the corruption.

Fast-Paced Pixel Combat –  Shoot with precision in animated pixel style.

Destroy the Blackrock – The fight isn’t over until the Blackrock is destroyed.

Story Development Status:

The core narrative and world of Blackrock are actively in development.
While the foundation of the story, factions, and setting is already established, the full narrative experience is being expanded step by step.

New story segments, characters, and contextual events will be added over time, further revealing the origins of the Blackrock, the role of the BCF, and the greater threat behind the corruption.

Story development is tightly integrated with gameplay updates, ensuring that new narrative content grows naturally alongside mechanics, environments, and progression systems.

Sidenote:

Blackrock originally began as a small learning project to explore coding, game design, and the possibilities of GameMaker. Over time, it steadily grew into a larger experience - one that continues to evolve.

This is a long-term passion project, developed and expanded step by step.

Development is ongoing, with regular updates, gameplay improvements, and new features planned.

Thank you for your interest in Blackrock. The fight against corruption has only just begun.

- Joe from Cavedwarf Studios

data.short_description: Command the BCF against sentient Blackrocks in this tactical top-down shooter base defense. Deploy Bravelings, fight Glimmergrubs, and destroy the Blackrock before it overwhelms everything.
data.reviews:
“Strategic and fast-paced, with engaging combat and fun unit deployment. A challenging and rewarding top-down shooter that keeps me coming back for more! Highly recommended.”
Awesome Games Review Group

“tactical top-down shooter with base defense elements! Engaging mechanics, diverse enemies, and strategic gameplay make it exciting. Perfect for fans of fast-paced combat and tactical challenges.”
OFEN™

“Игра сочетает в себе захватывающий сюжет и потрясающую графику. Динамичные бои и разнообразие персонажей делают процесс увлекательным. Рекомендую всем любителям экшенов!”
SOKOL- RUS

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual-Core
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 or better
  • Storage: 170 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Controller recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 or better
  • Storage: 170 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Controller recommended
